spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति)
To kill or hurt.

m. (-टः)
A year.
E.
उरु much, and अट to go, अच् aff.

f. (-रा)
1 Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop.
2 Land in general.
E.
उरू much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.

f. (-रा)
Fertile soil, land bearing any and every crop: see उर्व्वरा.

f. (-शी)
The name of one of the courtezans of Svarga or INDRA'S heaven.
E.
उरु great, वश to tame, अच् and ङीष् affixes; also उर्व्वसी and ऊर्व्वसी.

f. (-सी)
A nymph of Svarga: see उर्व्वशी. Also written ऊर्व्वशी.

m. (-णः)
The name of AILA or PURŪRAVAS, the second king of the line of the moon.
E.
उर्व्वशी, and रमण the gallant or husband of the Apsaras URVAŚĪ.

m. (-भः)
A name of AILA: see the preceding.
E.
as before, वल्लभ a friend, a lover, &c.

m. (-रुः)
A kind of cucumber, (cucumis^1 utilatissimus): see इर्व्वारु.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-र्व्वी)
The earth.
E.
उरु great, ङीष् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A mountain.
2 The serpent ŚEṢA.
E.
उर्व्वी the earth, and धर what holds.

m. (-हः)
A tree.
E.
उर्व्वी and रुह what grows on.

n. (-वः)
The thigh and knee.
E.
ऊरु and अष्ठीवत् the knee pan.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A mushroom.
E.
ऊर्व्वी for उर्व्वी the earth, and अङ्ग body: earth-born.
